text.tspan: Learning adjusted years of schooling in girls and boys2020
Learning-adjusted years of schooling merge the quantity and quality of education into one metric, accounting
for the fact that similar durations of schooling can yield different learning outcomes.
Data source: World Bank based on methodology in Filmer et al. (2018)
Note: Where data for 2020 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2015 and 2025 is shown instead.
